title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: This PR introduces an end-to-end cost-optimization automation bundle: sensible defaults and autotune hooks for batching and KV-prefix caching, a small set of quantization profiles and a first-pass unit-economics (UEcon) reporting pipeline integrated into Redwood Optimize. Motivation: teams repeatedly configure the same batching/caching knobs and quant profiles per model; automating defaults + surfacing UEcon makes it faster to get cost wins without manual tuning. Changes include: 1) autotune manager that proposes per-route defaults based on recent latency/throughput histograms; 2) runtime guards that apply batching and cache defaults with safe fallbacks; 3) three quantization profiles (int8-static, int8-dynamic, int4-research) with model compatibility metadata; 4) a lightweight UEcon exporter that computes token-level cost and latency breakdowns and sends them to the Optimize ingestion path; 5) console UI flag to preview recommended defaults and expected cost delta; 6) CLI helper to run offline simulation across traffic traces. The description below summarizes commits, touched files, testing, review conversation and merge notes.
